card.name: Last digit of computed dose numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit, often 5, 6 or 7, that completes a multi-digit or decimal dose figure in a dosing table or schedule, right before mg, g or mL.

modes.label: Decimal dose endings
modes.description: The digit after a decimal point in a calculated dose, such as .5 or .75.

modes.label: Final digit of whole-number doses
modes.description: The last digit of a three-digit dose in a dosing schedule, before mg.

card.plain: It fires on the last digit of an odd-looking dose number, like 117 mg or 562.5 mg, in dosing tables.
